annotations.title: Residential proxy brands that share infrastructure

description: Which residential proxy brands share infrastructure (their proxy gateways answer from the same addresses or resolve through the same DNS target), for one provider or for every brand ProxyRange covers. A gateway that is an alias of another brand’s host goes through that host; shared addresses alone are a technical link that doesn’t show who runs the network.
